examples.en: I ate an apple before school.
examples.zh: 我上学前吃了一个苹果。

examples.en: There is a small shop near our home.
examples.zh: 我们家附近有一家小商店。

examples.en: I am tired after basketball practice.
examples.zh: 篮球训练后我很累。

examples.en: The library is open until five today.
examples.zh: 图书馆今天开到五点。

examples.en: The child is drawing a picture of her dog.
examples.zh: 这个孩子正在画她的小狗。

examples.en: Many children play in the park after school.
examples.zh: 许多孩子放学后在公园玩。

examples.en: AI can help students practise English at home.
examples.zh: 人工智能可以帮助学生在家练习英语。

examples.en: My cousin used AI to make a picture for our class project.
examples.zh: 我表哥用人工智能为我们的班级项目制作了一张图片。

examples.en: I received a postcard from my friend yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天收到了朋友寄来的明信片。

examples.en: Our school will receive new books next week.
examples.zh: 我们学校下周会收到新书。

examples.en: Mia accepted her friend's invitation to the party.
examples.zh: 米娅接受了朋友的派对邀请。

examples.en: Dad accepted my apology after I said sorry.
examples.zh: 我道歉后，爸爸接受了我的道歉。

examples.en: I don't know whether the shop is open today.
examples.zh: 我不知道这家商店今天是否营业。

examples.en: We can play outside whether it rains or not.
examples.zh: 无论下不下雨，我们都可以在外面玩。

examples.en: About 60 per cent of our class walk to school.
examples.zh: 我们班大约百分之六十的同学步行上学。

examples.en: The shop gives a 20 per cent discount on school bags.
examples.zh: 这家商店的书包打八折。

examples.en: I missed the bus, so Dad drove me to school.
examples.zh: 我没赶上公交车，所以爸爸开车送我上学。

examples.en: Ella misses her grandparents when they are away.
examples.zh: 爷爷奶奶不在身边时，埃拉会想念他们。

examples.en: Miss Lee helped us find our classroom.
examples.zh: 李老师帮我们找到了教室。

examples.en: I gave the card to Miss Green after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我把卡片交给了格林老师。
